formbricks.name: Formbricks

bookstack.name: BookStack
bookstack.role: Client-facing 360° Audit Report, SOP knowledge base & 90-day roadmap portal

docuseal.name: DocuSeal
docuseal.role: Open-source DocuSign alternative for $750 Audit SOWs & 100% credit contracts

excalidraw.name: Excalidraw
excalidraw.role: Live interactive whiteboard for 360° workflow & bottleneck architecture mapping

grist.name: Grist
grist.role: Open-source relational spreadsheet & interactive SaaS-savings ROI modeler

stirling-pdf.name: Stirling-PDF
stirling-pdf.role: Self-hosted executive audit PDF compiler, merger, watermarker & redactor

kimai.name: Kimai Billing
kimai.role: Audit time tracking, $750 flat invoicing & 100% upgrade credit ledger
